description.en: Registers the enabled state of one map light slot for the HQ event system initialized by CMND_HQ_EVENT_INIT, so the cutscene's lighting is set up per map/light index.
Index of the map slot registered with CMND_REG_HDL_HQ_EVENT.
Index of the light slot to configure.
1 to enable that light, 0 to disable it.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).
